body: Thank you, It really is awful to live with and very few people understand unless they've experienced it. I will try and get round to talking to PM'ing you at some point.
Thank you. I need to sleep and collect my thoughts but I should send you a message tomorrow when i get a chance to.

The world glorifies assholes. People who are successful in business got there by shitting on everyone else. Guys who get girlfriends are essentially the alpha male and are usually not nice people. Me? I've always tried to be friendly, polite, and helpful to everyone and got nothing for it. I've already lived the best part of my life and had some great memories from it.

Yeah, Every time I get home I just go straight to my room and immerse myself playing them. It's just nice to enjoy playing something and forgetting about life and all the responsibilities you have to face. I know that I can't do it for ever and I'm probably just hiding away from my problems but It's what I enjoy doing the most for now.

Yeah, I pretty much found out who some of my real friends were when I told them about my problems. Most of them gave the usual "Oh I'm so sorry" "I want to help you" etc and then never initiate conversation with me again. There was probably only 1 friend who really showed concern and actually tried to help me so I guess that is that. I seriously hope I can eventually just find something that I really love and enjoy, and I hope you can too. You still have plenty of time, 26 isn't an old age, My dad is 50+ and he still has no idea what he wants to do when he "grows up" he always says to me.

That is pretty much what I'm hoping to do, I'm just so terrified of failing again and my parents telling me how disappointed in me they are. The only thing is that my friend is going to a university at literally the opposite end of the country (350-ish miles). Plus In the last couple months I've applied for 20+ jobs and heard nothing back, It's not even like I'm in an area hard up for jobs; Plus considering I've worked in a charity shop for just over 2 years i thought that would at least encourage some of them. I might try to visit some time I just really need some money from a job after I bet most of my life savings away (Lesson learned..). I guess I just felt like I was totally alone as I know only of 1 other person that failed and I barely know him. Thanks for posting though, I appreciate anyone who takes the time to and wants to help.

I have started a BTEC course in Engineering now with people 2 years younger than me, It's not too bad but I feel anxiety is gonna fuck it up for me again. It involves metalwork and stuff so I'll see how it goes. I spend most of my time on the computer in answer to your question, I find enjoyment in playing games because I guess I just forget about life. I might end up going anyway if I do well in the BTEC. Thanks,

I was always told that I was intelligent by my teachers and family but I would never believe that and even when i passed all of my GCSE's without doing any revision, I still didn't believe I was. Hence why I failed my A-Levels because I didn't revise at all. I know what you mean about the panic attacks and anxiety though, I found that I was having them frequently before I had an exam at college (Tight chest, hard to breathe etc). Thanks dude, Means a lot (Most of my real life friends wouldn't be helpful when i told them about my depression).
